## Standing operator rules
Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt.

separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions' in between your other work.

Rebase a task branch onto origin/main and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.

We tried pinning httpx to 0.23 to fix the TLS handshake errors and it broke the Stripe client. That path is ruled out.

Please paste exact test output. Keep commits small.

## Current objective
Fix the currency rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py` where JPY amounts get two decimal places. PDF export migration is paused and superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Branch: `gha/test-workflow`. Redis staging: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded and must not receive writes. Pagination: `InvoicePage(items,total,limit,offset)`. `httpx==0.23` is superseded and prohibited.

## Plan and progress
PDF migration steps 1–3 are done; 4–9 pending. GitHub Actions steps 1–4 are done; 5–9 pending. Next command is unavailable (status unknown).

## Recent work
PDF negative-credit rendering and shared `format_money()` were fixed; 12 baseline, 1 focused, and 3 formatting tests passed. Reports have 63 passed, 2 skipped and 37 stable queries. `ruff format --check` status is unknown. Currency investigation is next.
